descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S26 「现成 spec：未登录的浏览器在每个临床路由上都看到登录拦截（anonymous 项目）」 Existing specs: a signed-out browser gets the sign-in gate on every clinical route (anonymous project)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Each device goes through its own email-code sign-in (a new device always asks for a code). The two do not share a session token, and both stay valid at once.（TFA-94513 AC 6；TFA-94513 AC 10；UAT TC-25 step 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given A signed-out browser with empty storage (anonymous project)

When Open / and each clinical route directly, a chart's address included

Then Every route shows the sign-in gate, never the app: a new device always has to ask for a code

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in e2e/auth.anon.spec.ts, judged against T1's 'a new device always asks for a code' (TFA-94513 AC 6). Static evidence: a generic signed-out browser, not the computer opening the phone's chart while the phone is signed in (that is S13 cp0)

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S26

Existing specs: a signed-out browser gets the sign-in gate on every clinical route (anonymous project)

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Tim's two tests in e2e/auth.anon.spec.ts (anonymous project) for /rounding, /clinic, /snf, /rounding/sheet, /settings, plus our own spec tc25-anon-routes.spec.ts (runner qa-spec) for '/', a real Hospital and Nursing Home chart address and the other clinical routes: the scenario's when names '/' and a chart's address, which Tim's titles do not open. Both halves are in the patch. — Tim's tests exist on main (anonymous project); our complement covers what they do not open.

Detail:

Tim's two anonymous-project tests pass on the local stack (2/2, runs/2026-10-14-local/newspec-c/tc25-s26.json); they open /rounding, /clinic, /snf, /rounding/sheet, /settings. Our complement (tc25-anon-routes.spec.ts) opens '/', a real Hospital chart and a real Nursing Home chart address, both dashboards, add, tasks, handoff and /handoffs: 15/15 show the sign-in form and no chart content. The patch now wires both halves (Tim's titles + our title with runner qa-spec); without ours the scenario's '/' and chart-address routes would not be covered.

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's spec e2e/auth.anon.spec.ts, anonymous project): spec-matrix.mjs runs Tim's specs against the local stack only (E2E_PORT 6473) and has no dev target, so it runs on the local stack only, once spec-matrix passes --project=anonymous (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
